answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The grove is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pigment. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the summit of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
